entities.name: Jaka Klobučar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaka Klobučar is a Slovenian professional basketball player who was a member of the Slovenian national basketball team from 2007 to 2017. Standing at 1.98 m, he plays the point guard, shooting guard and small forward positions. During his career, he has won the Slovenian League championship four times and was named the Finals MVP in 2024.
